COMMENT ON TABLE press_db.hyb_job_rate_calculator
    IS 'Hybrid SQL+JSONB table storing AI Rate Calculator results. Relational columns for product config, IDs, totals (joins/filters/reporting). JSONB columns for parts, cost breakdown, BOM, AI insights, machine recommendations, and full input snapshot. Links to enquiry received process for quotation and negotiation workflow.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.hyb_job_rate_calculator.calc_input_snapshot

COMMENT ON TABLE press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code
    IS 'Master table for HSN (goods) and SAC (services) codes for GST compliance. Stores tax rates and classification details.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.id
    IS 'Primary key, auto-generated.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.code
    IS 'HSN or SAC code (unique identifier).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.code_type
    IS 'Type of code: HSN for goods, SAC for services.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.description
    IS 'Detailed description of the goods/service.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.parent_code
    IS 'Parent HSN/SAC code for hierarchical classification.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.level_no
    IS 'Classification level: 1=Chapter, 2=Heading, 3=Sub-heading, 4=Tariff item.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.tax_category_id
    IS 'FK to mst_tax_category for default tax slab.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.default_gst_rate
    IS 'Default total GST rate percentage (e.g., 18.000 for 18% GST).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.cgst_rate
    IS 'Central GST rate (for intra-state transactions).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.sgst_rate
    IS 'State GST rate (for intra-state transactions).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.igst_rate
    IS 'Integrated GST rate (for inter-state transactions).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.cess_rate
    IS 'Additional cess rate if applicable.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.category
    IS 'Business category (Paper Products, Printing Services, Inks, etc.).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_hsn_sac_code.is_commonly_used
    IS 'Flag for frequently used codes in printing press business.';

COMMENT ON TABLE press_db.mst_module
    IS 'Master table for ERP navigation modules and menu items. Supports hierarchical parent-child structure (up to 3 levels), section headers, badges, inline SVG icons, and separate mobile/web visibility flags. Seeded from mst_menu.csv — original menuid values are preserved as module_id.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.module_id
    IS 'Primary key. Preserved from original mst_menu.menuid values (1-1217). New rows after seeding use sequence press_db.mst_module_module_id_seq starting at 2000.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.module_code
    IS 'Unique business key for the module. Used by application layer for permission checks and role-menu mapping. e.g. DASHBOARD, SALES_CRM, RATE_CALCULATOR.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.module_name
    IS 'Display name shown in the navigation sidebar. e.g. Dashboard, Sales & CRM.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.parent_module_id
    IS 'Self-referencing FK. NULL for root/top-level modules (module_level=1). Points to parent module_id for child items (module_level=2).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.route_url
    IS 'Blazor client-side route for navigation. NULL for group header items that have no direct page (e.g. SALES_CRM, PRODUCTION).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.icon
    IS 'Tabler Icons icon name (without the ti- prefix). e.g. home, building-bank, package, chart-bar.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.display_order
    IS 'Render order within the parent group. Lower values appear first in sidebar.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.is_mobile
    IS 'true = visible in the .NET MAUI mobile app navigation. false = web-only (Blazor).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.is_web
    IS 'true = visible in the Blazor web application navigation.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.is_active
    IS 'Soft enable/disable. Inactive modules are hidden from all navigation.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.module_level
    IS '1 = root top-level item (section group). 2 = child leaf item under a root. 3 = reserved for future deep nesting.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.is_section_header
    IS 'If true, this row renders as a non-clickable section group label in the sidebar (e.g. Sales, CRM, Reports headings within a parent group).';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.section_name
    IS 'Label shown as a section divider above child items. e.g. Sales, CRM, Reports, Plate Making, Post-Press.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.badge_text
    IS 'Short badge label displayed on the menu item. e.g. New, Beta, Soon.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.badge_class
    IS 'Tabler/Bootstrap CSS classes for the badge. e.g. badge badge-sm bg-red-lt, badge badge-sm bg-blue-lt.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.has_divider_before
    IS 'If true, a horizontal <hr> divider is rendered above this menu item in the sidebar.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.icon_svg
    IS 'Full inline SVG markup for the icon. Used primarily for level-1 root items that require custom branded SVG icons rather than standard Tabler icon names.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.created_by
    IS 'Username or user ID of the person who created this record.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.created_on
    IS 'Timestamp when this record was created. Defaults to CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.modified_by
    IS 'Username or user ID of the person who last modified this record.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_module.modified_on
    IS 'Timestamp of the last modification. NULL if never updated after creation.';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_db.mst_process_notification_config
(
    config_id bigserial NOT NULL,
    process_id integer NOT NULL,
    subprocess_id integer NOT NULL,
    process_code character varying(30) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    subprocess_code character varying(30) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    department_id bigint NOT NULL,
    event_type_code character varying(30) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    event_label character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    approval_type_id integer,
    approval_level integer DEFAULT 0,
    recipient_type character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INTERNAL'::character varying,
    notify_assignee boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    notify_dept_head boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_supervisor boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_approver boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_client_sms boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_client_whatsapp boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_client_email boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_internal_sms boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_internal_whatsapp boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_internal_email boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_push boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    notify_topup_alert boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    template_code character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    subject_template character varying(300) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    body_template text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    sla_hours numeric(6, 2) DEFAULT 0,
    escalate_after_hours numeric(6, 2) DEFAULT 0,
    escalate_to character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    overdue_reminder_interval_hours numeric(6, 2) DEFAULT 0,
    trigger_on_status character varying(30) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    auto_trigger boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    trigger_condition text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    payload_config jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    ai_config jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    meta jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    priority character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL'::character varying,
    is_mandatory boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    sequence_no integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_by character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SYSTEM'::character varying,
    created_on timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    modified_by character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    modified_on timestamp without time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT mst_process_notification_config_pkey PRIMARY KEY (config_id)
);

COMMENT ON TABLE press_db.mst_process_notification_config
    IS 'Hybrid master: drives ALL notifications (task, approval, client, AI, overdue, escalation)
 for every subprocess across all 20 job processes.
 Relational columns → fast filter/join. JSONB → flexible payload & AI configuration.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_process_notification_config.payload_config
    IS 'JSONB: template variables list, per-channel enable/retry rules, recipient routing hints.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_process_notification_config.ai_config
    IS 'JSONB: AI model, prompt template, event category, auto-assign flag, threshold, fallback.';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_db.mst_user
(
    userid bigserial NOT NULL,

    ismultideviceallowed boolean DEFAULT false,

    lastotpverifiedat timestamp without time zone,

    allowediprange character varying(200) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",

    isdeleted boolean DEFAULT false,
    ispermissiononleave boolean DEFAULT false,

    lastpasswordchange timestamp without time zone,

    IS 'FK to shift type - used by AI agent to set accessfromtime/accesstotime automatically';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.ai_health_score
    IS 'User configuration health score (0-100) calculated by AI Smart Agent';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.ai_last_reviewed_at
    IS 'Last time AI agent reviewed this user configuration';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.ai_alert_count
    IS 'Number of active AI alerts for this user';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.ai_auto_configured
    IS 'Whether AI agent auto-configured roles/permissions based on dept+designation';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.company_id
    IS 'Primary company assignment for multi-company ERP setups';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.user_category
    IS 'AI classification: INTERNAL, CLIENT, VENDOR, CONTRACTOR, TEMPORARY';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.password_history
    IS 'JSON array of previous password hashes to prevent reuse';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.max_concurrent_sessions
    IS 'Maximum simultaneous login sessions allowed';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.user_type
    IS 'User classification: EMPLOYEE, CUSTOMER, VENDOR, ADMIN, OTHER. Determines entity linkage and access scope';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.mst_user.ref_id
    IS 'Reference ID to source entity: employee_id (mst_employee), party_id (mst_party), or other entity based on user_type';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_db.sys_error_log
(

    method_name character varying(500) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    exception_type character varying(500) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    message text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    stack_trace text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    inner_exception text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    request_path character varying(500) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    http_method character varying(10) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    request_data text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    user_id bigint NOT NULL,
    user_name character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    ip_address character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    user_agent character varying(500) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    correlation_id character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    tenant_key character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    severity character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Error'::character varying,
    additional_data text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    created_on timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    machine_name character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,

    reviewed_by character varying(100) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" DEFAULT ''::character varying,
    reviewed_on timestamp without time zone DEFAULT '1900-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone,
    CONSTRAINT sys_error_log_pkey PRIMARY KEY (error_log_id)
);

COMMENT ON TABLE press_db.sys_error_log
    IS 'Centralized error log for capturing exceptions across all application layers';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.sys_error_log.layer
    IS 'Application layer: UI, API, Infrastructure, Application, Persistence';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.sys_error_log.source
    IS 'Source component: Controller name, Service class, Repository, Blazor component, etc.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.sys_error_log.correlation_id
    IS 'Unique ID for tracing related log entries across services';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.sys_error_log.severity
    IS 'Severity level: Critical, Error, Warning, Info';

COMMENT ON TABLE press_db.trn_user_activity_log
    IS 'Generic user activity log capturing all actions across the complete ERP system. Tracks CRUD operations, approvals, status changes, exports, prints, logins, navigation, and any user-initiated action. Supports audit trail with before/after value snapshots. Uses JSONB for flexible activity metadata.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.trn_user_activity_log.module
    IS 'ERP module: JOB, ENQUIRY, QUOTATION, USER_MGMT, MASTER, CRM, DISPATCH, PAYMENT, QUALITY, STOCK, MACHINE_SCHEDULE, RATE_CALC, REPORT, AUTH, NOTIFICATION, DASHBOARD, SETTINGS';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.trn_user_activity_log.activity_type
    IS 'Action type: CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, VIEW, APPROVE, REJECT, PRINT, EXPORT, IMPORT, LOGIN, LOGOUT, STATUS_CHANGE, ASSIGN, UPLOAD, DOWNLOAD, SEND, CANCEL, CLOSE, REOPEN';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.trn_user_activity_log.activity_category
    IS 'Category: DATA (CRUD), AUTH (login/logout), NAVIGATION (page views), REPORT (report generation), APPROVAL (workflow), COMMUNICATION (email/sms/whatsapp), SYSTEM (background jobs)';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.trn_user_activity_log.old_values
    IS 'JSONB snapshot of previous field values before an UPDATE or DELETE. Used for audit trail and change history.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.trn_user_activity_log.new_values
    IS 'JSONB snapshot of new field values after a CREATE or UPDATE. Used for audit trail and change history.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.trn_user_activity_log.activity_data
    IS 'Flexible JSONB for context-specific metadata: report parameters, export format, filter criteria, approval remarks, etc.';

COMMENT ON COLUMN press_db.trn_user_activity_log.severity
    IS 'INFO: normal operations, WARNING: unusual activity, CRITICAL: security-sensitive actions, AUDIT: compliance-required logging';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_db.trn_user_notification
(
    user_notification_id bigserial NOT NULL,
    user_id bigint NOT NULL,
    notification_id bigint,
    title character varying(255) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    message text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    icon character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    color character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    module character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    event_type character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    reference_id integer,
    reference_url character varying(255) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    priority character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" DEFAULT 'NORMAL'::character varying,
    is_read boolean DEFAULT false,
    read_at timestamp without time zone,
    is_dismissed boolean DEFAULT false,
    dismissed_at timestamp without time zone,
    action_required boolean DEFAULT false,
    action_url character varying(255) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    action_label character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    expires_at timestamp without time zone,
    ai_generated boolean DEFAULT false,
    created_on timestamp without time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT trn_user_notification_pkey PRIMARY KEY (user_notification_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS press_db.user_login_log
(
    logid bigserial NOT NULL,
    userid bigint,
    loginat timestamp without time zone,
    logoutat timestamp without time zone,
    ipaddress character varying(45) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    deviceid character varying(200) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    channel character varying(20) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    CONSTRAINT user_login_log_pkey PRIMARY KEY (logid)
);
